checklist.step: Submit the Plan of Operations by April 1
actions: Assemble the Appendix IV Plan of Operations for the coming reinsurance year: states, plans of insurance, fund designations, financial and operational schedules.
Reconcile the Plan's state/plan scope to the product roadmap so nothing planned for release is missing from the Plan.
Upload through the RMA-designated channel by April 1 and save the submission confirmation.
Log the submission in the Internal Regulatory System and diarize FCIC's review questions window.
checklist.done: the Plan of Operations is submitted by April 1 with confirmation logged and scope reconciled to the roadmap.

checklist.step: Execute the SRA for the reinsurance year
actions: Review the new reinsurance year SRA terms against the prior year with the Head of Reinsurance and Chief Financial Officer, noting changed obligations.
Obtain board or delegated authority approval for execution where required by the governance framework.
Execute the SRA through the RMA process before the July 1 effective date and obtain the countersigned copy.
File the executed SRA in the compliance evidence repository and notify the release gate owner.
checklist.done: a countersigned SRA for the reinsurance year is filed before July 1 and the gate owner notified.

checklist.step: Confirm Plan of Operations approval before writing
actions: Track FCIC's review of the Plan, answering questions within the timelines FCIC sets.
Obtain the written Plan of Operations approval and check approved scope (states, plans, funds) against what was requested.
Where FCIC approves a narrower scope, notify the Insurance Product Manager immediately so out-of-scope releases stay gated.
File the approval letter and log the approval date in the Internal Regulatory System.
checklist.done: written Plan approval is filed, scope differences are flagged, and the approval date is logged.

checklist.step: Set the annual gate: no MPCI writing until both authorizations
actions: Keep the new reinsurance year's MPCI plans flagged 'blocked' in the Policy Administration Platform until both the executed SRA and the Plan approval letter are filed.
Verify the block covers quoting and binding across all channels including the agency/producer management system feeds.
On receiving both evidences, complete the annual gate checklist and lift the block with a dated record.
Notify Underwriting and Distribution leadership of the go-live with the authorization references.
checklist.done: the system block holds until both authorizations are evidenced, and the lift is a dated gate record.

checklist.step: Gate each state crop-hail release on disposition
actions: For every state release milestone in the product roadmap/backlog tool, attach the disposition statement from the Regulatory Filing Specialist (approval letter or computed deemer date).
Hold the milestone at 'blocked' until the statement shows approved or deemed status.
Cross-check the release's forms and rates match the approved filing versions via the Configuration Engineer's QA comparison.
Record the gate decision with date, decider and evidence links.
checklist.done: every state release milestone carries an evidenced disposition and a recorded gate decision.

checklist.step: Complete the release gate checklist per go-live
actions: Work the gate checklist for each release: authorization evidence attached, configuration QA passed, effective dates in system match the approved documents, sales closing dates respected, downstream eDAS coding ready.
Obtain the Insurance Product Manager's approval signature on the completed checklist.
Schedule the production promotion only after the checklist closes.
File the checklist in the compliance evidence repository under REG-056/C48.
checklist.done: each go-live has a signed, filed gate checklist preceding production promotion.

checklist.step: Control gate overrides
actions: Permit an override of any gate item only with written sign-off from both the Chief Underwriting Officer and Regulatory Counsel stating the basis.
Log every override in the regulatory filing/issue tracker with the risk accepted and a review date.
Report overrides to the Head of Compliance monthly — the expected count is zero.
Never override the SRA/Plan authorization items; those are absolute blocks.
checklist.done: overrides are dual-signed, logged and reported, and authorization items are never overridden.

checklist.step: Verify no premature writing occurred at the year turn
actions: After July 1, query the enterprise data warehouse for any new reinsurance year MPCI policy with a sales or binding date before both authorization dates.
Query state crop-hail bind dates against each state's disposition date.
Log any early policy as a zero-tolerance exception with the financial exposure (uninsured of reinsurance, lost A&O/risk subsidy) quantified with the Controller.
Report the query results, even when clean, to the Head of Compliance.
checklist.done: a post-turn query proves no writing preceded authorization, or exceptions are logged with quantified exposure.

checklist.step: Remediate any premature release
actions: Quarantine further sales on the affected product/state immediately.
With Regulatory Counsel, determine notification duties to RMA or the state and the policyholder remedy (re-issue, refund, or cure on authorization).
Execute the remedy and obtain Chief Underwriting Officer and Regulatory Counsel sign-off on closure.
Root-cause the gate failure and fix the control before the next release.
checklist.done: premature releases are quarantined, remedied with counsel, signed off and root-caused.

checklist.step: Keep gate calendars aligned to crop dates
actions: Load each crop's sales closing date, contract change date and earliest sales date from the RMA actuarial documents into the release calendar.
Alert the Insurance Product Manager when an approval timeline threatens a sales closing date, at least 30 days ahead.
Reconcile the calendar to the RMA dates each crop year.
checklist.done: release calendars carry current RMA crop dates with 30-day risk alerts.

checklist.step: Brief distribution before each go-live
actions: On gate lift, notify agencies and producers through the agency/producer management system of what may now be sold, in which states, from which date.
Withdraw any material referencing blocked products or states.
Confirm the Broker & Agent Portal shows only released products.
File the notification evidence with the gate record.
checklist.done: distribution channels reflect exactly the released scope with notification evidence filed.

checklist.step: Report gate status to governance
actions: Report quarterly to the Chief Underwriting Officer: releases gated, released, overrides (target zero) and the authorization calendar status for April 1 and July 1.
Escalate any authorization at risk 60 days ahead.
Minute the review and file it.
checklist.done: quarterly gate reporting reaches the Chief Underwriting Officer with minutes filed.

checklist.step: Archive the annual authorization evidence
actions: File the executed SRA, Plan of Operations submission and approval, annual gate checklist and the post-turn verification query under REG-056/C48/<reinsurance year>.
Apply the 3-years-after-annual-settlement retention rule and lock the folder.
Index for 5-business-day production to RMA.
checklist.done: the reinsurance year's authorization evidence is archived, locked and indexed.

checklist.step: Refresh the gate procedure each reinsurance year
actions: Diff the new SRA's Sections IV(f)(2) and IV(l) and the Preamble for authorization changes.
Update the gate checklist and re-approve with the Chief Underwriting Officer and Head of Compliance before April 1.
Brief the Release Coordinator and Product teams on changes.
checklist.done: the gate procedure is re-approved against the new SRA before the Plan submission.

checklist.step: Test the block mechanics before the year turn
actions: In the pre-production environment, attempt to quote and bind a new-year MPCI policy while the gate block is set, across direct and portal channels.
Confirm every attempt is refused with the correct block message.
Attach the test evidence to the annual gate checklist.
Re-run after any system release that touches the binding path.
checklist.done: block mechanics are proven by failed bind attempts in every channel before July 1.

actions: Set scope to the reinsurance year turn plus all product releases in the year.
List assertions: April 1 and July 1 evidence, block integrity, gate checklists per release, zero premature writing, override control.
Confirm independence from Product Operations.
Open the workpaper under REG-056/C48.
testing.done: a scoped, independent annual test plan is documented.

actions: Inspect the countersigned SRA and the Plan of Operations approval letter in the archive, checking dates and the reinsurance year.
Verify the Plan was submitted by April 1 from the submission confirmation.
Compare the approved scope (states, plans) to what was released in the year.
testing.done: authorization documents are verified authentic, dated and scope-consistent with releases.

actions: Export all crop release milestones marked done in the year from the product roadmap/backlog tool.
Reconcile against production deployment logs from the Policy Administration Platform.
Flag any deployment without a milestone as an exception.
testing.done: the release population reconciles to production deployments.

testing.step: Trace every release to a gate record
actions: For each release, retrieve the signed gate checklist and its attached authorization or disposition evidence.
Any release without a completed checklist is a zero-tolerance fail.
Record the trace rate.
testing.done: every release traces to a signed gate record or is failed.

actions: Write an independent query against the enterprise data warehouse comparing every new-year MPCI sales/binding date to the later of the SRA execution and Plan approval dates.
Repeat for crop-hail binds against state disposition dates.
Compare results to the Compliance Analyst's post-turn query and investigate any difference.
testing.done: an independent query confirms (or refutes) zero premature writing.

actions: Verify the April 1 submission date and July 1 effective date arithmetic from source timestamps.
For sampled state releases, recompute deemer dates used at the gate.
Log any date reliance that does not hold.
testing.done: all gate date arithmetic is independently recomputed.

actions: Pull all gate overrides from the tracker and verify each carries both Chief Underwriting Officer and Regulatory Counsel signatures.
Confirm no override touched the SRA/Plan authorization items.
Verify monthly override reporting to the Head of Compliance occurred.
testing.done: overrides are fully dual-signed, within permitted scope, and reported.

actions: Observe or re-perform a blocked-bind attempt in the pre-production Policy Administration Platform with a gated product.
Verify the QA evidence attached to the annual checklist matches this behavior.
Log any channel where the block does not hold.
testing.done: block behavior is directly observed and matches the filed QA evidence.

actions: Record exceptions with root cause, quantified exposure and owner in the tracker.
Retest prior-year exceptions and close or escalate repeats.
Escalate any premature-writing finding immediately to the Chief Underwriting Officer and Head of Compliance.
testing.done: exceptions are logged with exposure and priors are dispositioned.

actions: Review the workpaper, queries and exception log.
Issue a written conclusion against the zero-tolerance standard on premature release.
Sign, file in the compliance evidence repository, and report to the Chief Underwriting Officer, General Counsel and Head of Compliance.
testing.done: a signed annual conclusion on REG-056-C48 is filed and reported.
